lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; the pass reply's asset.h_bonus_mixed (placed in 2025 and asset.bonus_same false) refuses asset.bonus_2025 whatever asset.bonus_choice is, so it asks asset.bonus_same of 2025 property whose choice is none; the project asks it only on the full and forty branches (asset.bonus_full, asset.bonus_forty refuse on asset.bonus_mixed). i4562 p. 7, Election out: "You can elect, for any class of property, to not deduct any special depreciation allowance for all such property in such class placed in service during the tax year" makes the same-class question matter only where an allowance is claimed. Same point as the backlog and refresh rulings. The values are now representation: the reply's dep_2025 is the table rate times its (c), which for 2025 property is cost times business use less the section 179 cost and the special allowance, the project's 19(g) basis (asset.ub); the refresh round's added line 14 is gone (i4562 p. 9, Line 17 and Lines 19a Through 19j). Round-2 rulings are from reading the pass reply (.transcription/asset.lines-70ea95948c1d) against the project; triage was not rerun.

Ruling: representation; i4562 p. 9, Line 17, "enter the deductions for the current year". For property placed before 2025 the reply takes the table rate (the convention used when placed in service, the recovery year from asset.placed) times the business cost less the earlier section 179 deduction and special allowance, zero after the recovery period; the project's line 17 reads the same answers (asset.prior_179, asset.prior_bonus). The reply's bonus refusal is not reached for property placed before 2025 (asset.h_bonus_mixed is false there). Same reading as the refresh-round ruling. Round-2 rulings are from reading the pass reply (.transcription/asset.lines-70ea95948c1d) against the project; triage was not rerun.

Ruling: representation; i4562 p. 11, Column (c): "multiply the cost or other basis of the property by the percentage of business/investment use. From that result, subtract any credits and deductions allocable to the property". The reply's (c) subtracts the section 179 deduction and the special allowance; the project's (c) is the basis before them (its label) and the form's column (c) after them is 19(c) (asset.col19c). Its 2-place proration equals the project's 6 places, asset.pct being a whole percent. Triage executable-triage-v2 (reviews/2025/transcription/triage/asset.json; 1,638 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 725 partial records): 644 of 1,403 comparisons agree; on completed returns 90 value differences, each the deductions the reply subtracts here (e.g. classm.g28.1.deepseek item_1 $46,128.00/$0.00, an asset fully expensed), and 17 candidate-unknown where the reply asks asset.bonus_same, which the source does not need when no allowance is elected. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained, as the earlier rulings. i4562 p. 5, Line 14. Both give 100% of the business basis less section 179 for full with asset.after_jan19 true, 40% for forty, and 40% for full with asset.after_jan19 false, and zero for none; the reply's business basis (asset.cost times asset.pct over 100, two places) is the project's (c), asset.pct being a whole percent. The reply also zeroes the amount for property not placed in service in 2025 or outside the tool's classes; the project figures each per-asset amount and selects 2025 property where the totals are taken (asset.bonus_2025 and the where-filters of the sc sums), and refuses outside classes through asset.outside. This round changed only the wording of asset.after_jan19 (the written binding contract rule), not an expression. Project stands.
